{subject} was family. {killer} will regret this.
Rest now, {subject}. I hope {killer} runs, because I am coming.
I heard {subject} did not make it back.
They say {subject} stayed behind so others could escape.
Someone says {subject} cannot keep track of their own gear.
{subject} talked big, then backed down when it mattered.
Watch {subject}; their story keeps changing.
{subject} left someone behind when the zombies closed in.
People have spotted danger near {place}.
I got away when a whole horde came after me.
Word is {subject} was seen near {place}.
{subject} has been looking out for people.
{subject} stood up for someone when an attacker closed in.
{subject} got someone home alive.
I heard what happened to {subject}. I hope they are holding up.

conversation.bundle.greetings.ambient.vi.text: Thank you. I could use somewhere safe to rest for a while.

conversation.bundle.greetings.hostile.pa.text: The survivor watches you carefully, ready to fight.
You ask for a short ceasefire.

conversation.bundle.greetings.member.mem.text: You're up. Good—we have plenty to do.
Morning. I already checked the perimeter.
Couldn't sleep either? We may as well get started.
First light. What's the plan today?
Morning. Everyone else is still asleep, so it's just us.
Evening. Perimeter looks clear.
Need me for something before night watch?
We're all still here. I'll call that a good day.
Keep it quiet. The others are settling down.
I can take first watch if you need the rest.
Morning. Ready when you are.
Good, you're here. What are we doing today?
Another day with the crew. Could be worse.
Morning. Supplies are holding for now.
I was about to look for you. What's up?
We made it through the day. That's something.
Hey. Need a hand before we wrap up?
Long day, but I'm still ready if you need me.
Everyone accounted for?
The light's fading. We should finish up soon.
You're supposed to be resting. What's wrong?
Quiet night so far. Let's keep it that way.
I'm on watch. Did you need something?
Good, it's you. I heard footsteps.
Can't sleep? Pull up a chair, but keep your voice low.

conversation.bundle.greetings.neutral.ac.text: You're awake early too. Everything all right?
Morning. I didn't expect to see you before sunrise.
Couldn't sleep? Neither could I.
Good, it's you. What brings you over this early?
Dawn patrol, or did you need something?
Evening. Need something before we turn in?
Good, it's only you. You startled me.
Not much daylight left. Talk to me.
Hey. Keeping watch, or just passing by?
We should keep this quiet, but I'm listening.
Morning. Good to see a familiar face.
Hey. How's the day treating you?
There you are. Need a minute?
Morning. You look like you have something on your mind.
Nice to see you made it through another night.
Hey. Been a long day?
Good timing. I was about to settle in.
There you are. Find anything useful today?
The day's winding down. What's up?
You look tired. Everything okay?
Late night. What has you awake?
It's good to see someone I recognize out here.
Keep it down. Sound carries at night.
You all right? It's late to be wandering.
Hey. Make it quick before we draw attention.

conversation.bundle.greetings.neutral.fi.text: Hold there. I don't know you, and dawn is a strange time for introductions.
You're up before the dead settle down. Who are you?
Easy. The light is barely up, and I wasn't expecting company.
Morning, I suppose. Keep your hands where I can see them.
First light and a new face. Tell me what you need.
Stop there. Dusk makes strangers hard to read.
Not much light left. Introduce yourself.
You surprised me. What do you want?
Keep your voice down and tell me why you're here.
I can't make out your face. Come no closer.
Morning. I haven't seen you around before.
That's close enough. Start with your name.
New face. Are you passing through or looking for something?
Daylight makes this easier. Who are you?
I don't recognize you. Talk, and keep it calm.
You picked a late hour to approach a stranger.
The light is going. Say what you came to say.
I don't know you, but I'm listening.
Before it gets dark, tell me who you are.
Another survivor. Friendly, I hope?
It's dark out. Stay where I can see you.
A stranger walking up at night usually means trouble.
Keep your voice low. Who are you?
You chose a bad time to sneak up on someone.
Don't move any closer. We can talk from there.

conversation.bundle.greetings.settlement.text: Please… let me stay. We have been walking for days, and I do not know how much longer the others can keep going.
I am not asking for much. A roof, a meal, and a chance to be useful. Please let us join you.
You have a settlement. We have nothing left but each other. If there is room, I will work for it.
Thank you. I thought I would have to keep walking until there was nowhere left to go.

conversation.bundle.greetings.special.lo.text: You're awake already. I was hoping you'd sleep a little longer.
Morning, love. Come here before the day starts.
I missed you, and you were only asleep.
First light looks better with you here.
Couldn't sleep without checking on everyone, could you?
Stay with me a minute before night watch.
Evening, love. You look exhausted.
You're safe. I can breathe again.
Come closer. We don't get many quiet moments.
I saved you a place by me.
Morning, love. You sleep all right?
There you are. I was starting to miss you.
Good morning. Stay close today, okay?
Seeing you first thing still makes this place feel almost normal.
Morning. Whatever happens today, we handle it together.
There you are. I worried when you were gone so long.
Come sit with me before the light goes.
Long day. I'm glad you're here at the end of it.
You made it back. That's all I needed to see.
The sunset almost makes this place look peaceful.
Can't sleep? Neither can I.
It's all right. I'm here.
Come sit with me. We can keep watch together.
You scared me walking around this late.
Stay close tonight. I mean it.

conversation.bundle.needs.member.basic.c.text: I have something you might need.
I will hold on to the rest.
What supplies are we short on?

conversation.bundle.needs.member.basic.g.text: Choose something to give me, then return to the conversation.
That is exactly the kind of contribution that keeps a community moving.
Perfect timing. I will make sure it reaches someone who needs it.
Thank you. I will put it where it does the most good.
This goes straight into our reserves. You just made the whole group safer.

conversation.bundle.needs.member.basic.o.text: Let me think about what the group is short on.

conversation.bundle.needs.member.basic.r.text: Let me see what you can spare.
Nothing urgent, but check the bandages.
Food, water, and tools. The usual.

conversation.bundle.needs.neutral.basic..text: I have something you might need.
I will hold on to the rest.
Take these if you can use them: {giftItemSummary}.
Choose something to give me, then return to the conversation.
Good choice. Something like this can keep a bad day from getting worse.
This will not go to waste. I appreciate you sharing it with me.
I can make use of this. Thank you.
That is useful. Thank you for thinking ahead instead of waiting for a crisis.
There are a few things I could use.
Let me see what you can spare.
Nothing I cannot handle right now.
Food and clean water never hurt.

conversation.bundle.needs.special.basic..text: I have something you might need.
I will hold on to the rest.
These are yours if you need them: {giftItemSummary}.
Here's {giftItemName}. I thought you could use it.
Choose something to give me, then return to the conversation.
Useful, deliberate, and well chosen. You are learning how I think.
You remembered me. I will enjoy this, and I will remember the gesture.
That is thoughtful of you. Thank you.
You noticed what I needed before I had to ask. That means more than the medicine itself.
Since it's you, I'll tell you what I need.
Let me see what you can spare.
No. I would tell you if I was.
Just come back safely. Anything else is extra.

conversation.bundle.personal.special.bas.text: You do not know each other well enough yet.
All right, {playerFirstName}. We can talk about us.
I know. That still means more than I can say.

conversation.bundle.relationship.special.text: This relationship is not close enough yet.
I'm listening, {playerFirstName}. Say what you need to say.

conversation.bundle.set.territory.member.text: We have enough people to stop surviving from one night to the next. Pick a place, mark it as ours, and we can start building something that lasts.
Then let us find ground worth defending. I will help turn it into home.

conversation.bundle.small.talk.member.ba.text: A quiet conversation sounds good right now.
Could be worse. We've worked through worse.

conversation.bundle.small.talk.neutral.b.text: All right. We can talk for a minute.
Do not tempt fate, but I'll take it.
At least the rain covers our footsteps.

conversation.bundle.small.talk.special.b.text: I always have time for you, {playerFirstName}.
Then spend part of it with me.
I barely noticed. I was watching you.

semantic.question.identity.wary_alt_2.text: After that lie, I'm not telling you my name. Tell me the truth about yours.
